questions.stem: If a CPU scheduler allocates 10 ms of CPU time to each process in a round-robin scheduling algorithm, how much time will it take to complete one full cycle for 5 processes? Provide your answer in milliseconds.
questions.explanation: In a round-robin scheduling algorithm, each process gets an equal share of CPU time. With 5 processes and 10 ms per process, one full cycle takes 5 x 10 ms = 50 ms.

questions.stem: Explain why virtual memory is important in modern operating systems.
markingGuide: Virtual memory allows systems to use more memory than physically available.
It uses disk space to extend RAM, enabling larger applications to run.
Virtual memory improves system stability and multitasking capabilities.
questions.explanation: Virtual memory is crucial as it allows systems to run applications that require more memory than is physically available. By using disk space as an extension of RAM, it enables larger applications to run and improves system stability and multitasking.
